name: Summer and Score Through the Doors
detailed_description:
"Summer and Score Through the Doors" is a realistic story AVG+ war chess RPG game

The game depicts a variety of real-life high school and college lives of the 7 protagonists, narrating stories about chasing dreams and finding identities. Confronted with shackles from reality, can their dreams finally come true? And when endings of the stories are directed to the same singularity, can you break the seemingly unsolvable fate?

In order to better show the plot, the game has added micro-innovative war chess gameplay. Feel the emotions you feel in the plot, whether it's sadness, joy, or anger, turn them into heavy punches against your enemies.

Gameplay has a variety of difficulties to choose from. Low difficulty makes it easy to get through the story, while higher difficulty is for players who love to challenge themselves!

 

Features of this game

  • Realistic plot background

Those doors are the only supernatural element – it's a realistic tale in a realistic style.

The game is set in the real world, and emotions conveyed throughout the plot are naturally all derived from reality, so there are always a few that can resonate with you.

  • Unique battle experience

Here, you'll experience a whole new way of fighting: your book is shield, your pen is sword--use skills of various subjects to get a high score!

Each subject has unique mechanics. For example, Physics class can store energy to enhance status; Chemistry class can trigger "chemical reactions" with enemies' debuffs; Biology class can summon creatures to assist in battle. If you are fond of a subject, its skill effects may make you smile.

Of course, not every battle is set in the background of an exam, maybe it's a confrontation with the will of others, maybe it's a clash of inner emotions, maybe even a weird dream...... Even so, get as high a score as possible!

  • Score is important, keep your determination

For students, the importance of score is self-evident, as the saying goes, "one more point, kill a thousand".

Thus, in battle, you and your enemy will constantly compete for each other's scores. Meanwhile, you'll constantly confront a tough trial – the score target. Rewards for an A, and penalties for an F.

Even when situation is tough, keep your determination. By gaining score and performing skills, you can accumulate determination points, and enter Determined state, to gain buffs, and use powerful Awakening Skills in the later stages of the game to turn the situation around!

Characters

"Why did I mess it up again...what have I done wrong..."

An ordinary 'test taker' girl, who works tirelessly to meet the expectations of her parents and teachers.

she will use the power of mathematics in battle, employing rigorous reasoning logic to enhance her status level.

"Don't worry, teacher. Trust me, there are no difficulties that I can't overcome."

The 'trophy child' who has repeatedly been ranked first in their grade since childhood is preparing to showcase their skills in physics competitions for their ambitious research dreams.

he will use the power of physics in battle, storing and releasing various energies to create explosive effects.

More characters will be unlocked when the official version is released.

short_description: This is one (or more) story of reality, a story of youth, dreams, chains, and rebellion. Step into different lives of 7 ordinary teens through the "Doors", and to rewrite their fate tightly locked with your choices.
